# fallbuild

> ⚙ FallBuild · sovereign Oracle APEX wedge · drag-drop low-code app builder · 8 widget types · FallBase bindings · 5 templates · standalone-HTML export with runtime baked · single HTML · MIT · prime 547

fallbuild is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
